description: This file defines the ShellExecutor utility within an application, providing asynchronous methods to execute shell commands with detailed results and timeout handling.

classes.name: ShellResult
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the output and status of a shell command execution.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a command with optional working directory, environment variables, and timeout; returns a detailed result.

methods.name: run
methods.description: A higher-level method that runs a command and returns a Response object indicating success or failure.
